page.layout: One page of text, centred. Top: decorative ornament (not transcribed). Below it: a dedication address in centred, mostly capitalised lines, ending with the dedicatory sentence and the name of the dedicator. Below that: a decorative ornament band. Foot of page: a closing "D" at centre and the catchword "CAN-" at right. No margin notes. A library stamp at lower right is not transcribed.

main_text.head: VIRIS MAGNIFICIS ET EXCELLENTISSIMIS, Medicis Basilien sibus ornatissimis, DN. DD. CASPARO BAVHINO, BASILIENSIS ACADEMIAE RECTO- ri, Anatomes & rei Herbariæ Pro- fessori eximio, &c. CLARISSIMO QVOQ. VIRO, DD. FELICI PLATERO ARCHIATRO, ORDINIS MEDICO- rum Decurioni spectatissimo, & Practicæ Medicinæ Profess. celeberr. Necnon reliquis Senatus Medici Doctoribus & Professoribus, D.D. HENRICO PANTA- LEONI, S. C. P. C. ET PROFESSO- ri Physicæ ordinario; DN.D. IOAN. NICOL. STVPANO, ME- dicinæ Theoricæ Profess. ornatissimo; ET D. D. THOM. COCCIO, MORALIS PHILOSO- phiæ Profesfori præstantissimo, &c. Studiorum suorum Autoribus, Fautoribus, Præceptoribus,& Patronis perpetuo honorandis,
main_text.p: Hasce Theses Medicas inaugurales pro suo in Illustrium Basil. Medico- rum ordinem Candore, Amore, ac obseruantiæ promeritæ,& im- mortalis gratiarum actionis ergò Offert,Nuncupat,Dicat.

page.notes: The scan is slightly rotated and some letters are worn; readings are from the image as displayed. "Basilien sibus" is printed with a space and is copied as printed. "Profesfori" in the Coccio line is copied as it appears on the scan. The top-right pencil numeral and the circular library stamp are not transcribed. The "D" at the foot is taken as the gathering signature and "CAN-" as the catchword.
